title: GTA 6 physical map leaks: new Leonida places revealed
description: The GTA 6 physical map from the Collector's Box has leaked, reportedly showing new Leonida places like Port Gellhorn. Rockstar hasn't confirmed it.

body.text: A GTA 6 physical map from Rockstar's Collector's Box has leaked a week before launch, according to tbreak. Photos of the printed Leonida poster are circulating online and reportedly name places fans hadn't seen before. Rockstar hasn't confirmed any of it, and standard physical copies of the game don't come with a printed map. For anyone planning their first trip through the new state, it's an early look, with caveats.
What the GTA 6 physical map reportedly shows

Beebom counted five major counties, 11 islands and keys, 13 towns and cities, and nine other named locations on the poster, including Grassrivers. It describes the map as far bigger than anything in earlier GTA games. Vice City is on it, but the unfamiliar names are what fans are talking about.

Notebookcheck picked out Lummox County in the north, along with Moreau and Pelican Valley in Grassrivers further south. It also spotted Goose Key in the southern section. Beebom adds Port Gellhorn and Ambrosia to the list. Notebookcheck says that, apart from a few edges such as the Leonida Keys, most regions and labels can be read.
Colour does some of the work, according to egw.news: red marks urban areas, yellow and orange mark countryside, and green covers wilderness, nature reserves and zoos.

Treat it as an illustration, not a satellite view. VGC says the images appear to show a stylised version of the GTA 6 map. Insider Gaming says it is most likely not an accurate copy of the in-game map, but it is what fans currently have to go on. ComicBook adds that only part of the map has leaked, not all of it.

A second stylised map is also making the rounds, and some fans think it is the reverse side of the poster. VGC says no other sources are sharing that image, so it remains unconfirmed. Beebom says that side hasn't appeared in the leak yet.

The first photo came from X user @GazzaMontana, who saw the box on display at a Selfridges store in Manchester, with the map folded inside. VGC reports the clearest image reportedly came from an Instagram account that has since been deleted. Insider Gaming says someone has claimed the image came from a Selfridges employee, but nobody has verified that.

VGC says Selfridges doesn't sell the box and that it appears to have been a display item. RockstarINTEL's sources, however, say the Manchester store had one box on sale and has since sold it. The two accounts conflict.
Collector's Box price and release date

The poster is one of 11 items in Rockstar's Goodtime State – Vice City Collection. It costs $399.99 in the US and £349.99 in the UK, and the source gives no Indian pricing. It is merchandise, not a game edition, so buyers still need GTA 6 itself.

items: A six-inch Macca the Gator figure

body.text: You don't need the box to get the map. Notebookcheck says Rockstar will release a downloadable digital map on or shortly after launch day. GTA 6 itself arrives on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S on 19 November.

The real test comes in a week, when players can compare the leaked poster with the actual Leonida. Watch for Rockstar's digital map, any official word on the poster, and whether the second image turns out to be the back of it. Until then, the new place names are fan fodder, not confirmed fact.
